notes: Thai has no spaces between words; sentences are single lines so no wrap happens, but spaces inside the strings are real separators. The charges table has three spanned section rows (ค่าห้องพัก, อาหารและเครื่องดื่ม, บริการอื่น ๆ; text repeated in each of the three cells) and four totals rows whose date cell is empty. List markers are typed Thai numerals '๑.' '๒.' '๓.' and Thai letters 'ก.' 'ข.' (nested). Dates use the Buddhist-era year 2569. HarfBuzz shaping in MuPDF stacks vowels and tone marks above and below the base; a reader that does not apply the ToUnicode map may lose or reorder those marks. Digits in amounts are ASCII.
